lede: Tuesday's Town Council meeting is the one to watch this week — a newly seated Council takes up second reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code, which would amend land use rules covering historic review and landscaping standards for the whole town. That same Tuesday, the Telluride Housing Authority considers a new primary residency policy for dependents of multiple custodial parents, and Planning & Zoning tackles the Carhenge Redevelopment on Thursday with subdivision and concept review for Town-owned land on West Pacific.

notable.stake: Second reading vote on wildfire code changes to land use and landscaping rules.
New primary residency policy for dependents could affect housing eligibility determinations.
Public review of subdivision and concept plans for Carhenge and other Town-owned sites.
